fields.bio: University student looking to help my community while earning extra income. Reliable and hardworking.
I enjoy helping others and have a lot of free time between classes. Happy to assist with errands, tech, or chores.
Friendly and patient — especially good with seniors. Available most weekdays.
Recent high school grad with time to spare. I'm handy around the house and love animals.
I've helped elderly neighbors my whole life and want to make it official. Trustworthy and punctual.
Part-time student, full-time helper! I drive and can assist with shopping, appointments, or odd jobs.
Experienced with garden work and basic home repairs. Happy to help with anything physical.
Tech-savvy and patient. Great at explaining things slowly — phones, tablets, computers, no problem.
Retired teacher. I live alone and sometimes need a helping hand with errands and technology.
78 years old, still active but could use help with heavier tasks around the house.
I love my garden but my knees don't cooperate anymore. Looking for someone reliable and kind.
Widower, living independently. I need occasional help with grocery runs and appointments.
I'm fiercely independent but smart enough to ask for help when I need it!
Recently moved to a new apartment and need help getting settled and organized.
Looking for someone patient to help me with my phone and computer. My grandchildren are too busy!
Retired engineer. I can manage most things but appreciate help with the heavy lifting.

fields.title: Mowing the lawn
fields.description: I need help mowing my lawn, it is an area of 5000 sq meters, it should take around an hour

fields.title: help with expense report
fields.description: I need help to file my receipts into an excel sheet to file for an expense report this job should take a couple hours

fields.title: house cleaning
fields.description: I need help to clean my house, it should take around an 1h30 to complete

fields.title: Hanging up paintings
fields.description: I need help to hand up a few paintings around the house

fields.title: Grocery run to IGA
fields.description: I need someone to pick up my weekly groceries at the IGA on Sherbrooke. I'll give you the list and money beforehand. Should take about an hour.

fields.title: Help setting up my new iPad
fields.description: My daughter bought me a new iPad for my birthday and I have no idea how to set it up. Need someone patient to help me get started with email and video calls.

fields.title: Moving furniture in living room
fields.description: I'd like to rearrange my living room furniture but it's too heavy for me. Just a couch, two armchairs and a bookshelf. Shouldn't take more than an hour.

fields.title: Spring cleaning help
fields.description: Looking for someone to help with a thorough spring cleaning — windows, baseboards, and getting into corners I can't reach anymore. About 3-4 hours of work.

fields.title: Lawn mowing and hedge trimming
fields.description: My backyard lawn needs mowing and the hedges along the fence need a trim. I have all the equipment. About 2 hours of work.

fields.title: Drive to medical appointment
fields.description: I have a doctor's appointment downtown and no longer drive. Need a ride there and back, about 2 hours total including waiting time.

fields.title: Set up online banking on my computer
fields.description: My bank is pushing me to use online banking but I'm nervous about doing it alone. Need someone to sit with me, help set it up, and show me how it works safely.

fields.title: Hang 4 picture frames
fields.description: I have 4 framed photos I'd like to hang in the hallway. I have a hammer and nails but my hands shake too much to do it myself.

fields.title: Dog walking — twice daily for a week
fields.description: I'm recovering from a minor surgery and can't walk my golden retriever Biscuit for about a week. Twice a day, 20 minutes each walk in the neighbourhood.

fields.title: Help filling out government forms
fields.description: I received some forms from the government and I'm confused by the language. Need someone to sit with me and help fill them out correctly.

fields.title: Plant flowers in front garden
fields.description: I bought a flat of petunias and marigolds from the nursery. Just need someone to help me plant them — I'll direct, you dig! About 1.5 hours.

fields.title: Help organizing my basement
fields.description: My basement has accumulated years of stuff. I need someone energetic to help me sort, box, and carry things to donate. Could be a 2-day project.

fields.title: Change smoke detector batteries
fields.description: I have 6 smoke detectors and a carbon monoxide detector, all beeping. I can't safely climb a ladder anymore. Simple job for someone tall!

fields.title: Teach me how to use WhatsApp
fields.description: My family uses WhatsApp to share photos and do group calls but I can't figure it out. Need a patient teacher for about an hour.

fields.title: Pick up prescription from pharmacy
fields.description: My prescription is ready at the Jean Coutu on Notre-Dame but I'm not feeling well enough to go out. Need someone to pick it up and drop it off.
